title: Dynamics 365 Finance: ERP Analytics MCP gives agents access to Business performance analytics data
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, preview prerequisites, BPA security controls and qualified Copilot Studio billing statements are supported. The user-setup path could be more complete, and the first-sign-in administrator statement needs to acknowledge Microsoft's different installation guidance for BPA version 2.5.

claims.quote: Agent not finding the MCP server: Verify Business performance analytics v2.4.3224 or higher is installed. Ensure you have appropriate permissions in your Power Platform environment. Check that the ERP Analytics MCP server is enabled.

claims.claim: Business performance analytics > Administration > Set up user opens user setup for BPA access.
claims.quote: In Business performance analytics, on the Administration or Users page, select Set up user. Search for the user name or email address ... Select Next. Assign at least one role and one dimension group to the user.
claims.fix: Keep the documented entry path, but append to controls[1].note: 'The control is the role and dimension-group assignment on the next setup page.' The full procedure is Business performance analytics > Administration > Set up user, search for the user, select Next, then assign at least one role and one dimension group, as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/finance/business-performance-analytics/set-up-security.

claims.claim: No API or automation equivalent of BPA user setup with its report roles and dimension groups is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Business performance analytics Set up user automation PowerShell API. Read set-up-security and search excerpts for access-bpa and Dataverse aad-group-team; platform role assignment does not document BPA dimension-group user setup.

claims.quote: Assign at least one role and one dimension group to the user.

claims.quote: on the Administration page, select Set up dimension groups. ... Enter a name for the dimension group, and then select Next. ... Select Select specific values to select the exact dimension values to use in a dimension group.

claims.claim: An API for BPA dimension-group value selection is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Business performance analytics dimension groups Web API; Business performance analytics dimension group entity reference. Read set-up-security; no matching BPA dimension security API reference found.

claims.claim: Dimensions must be secured before dimension groups can be created.
claims.quote: Set up dimension groups. You can create dimension groups only after completing step 1.

claims.claim: Dimension-group setup requires a group name and Next before selecting specific values.

claims.claim: The first user who signs in to BPA becomes BPA admin.
claims.quote: The first user who signs in to the app is assigned the BPA admin role.
claims.fix: Replace the sentence with: 'The security setup page says the first user who signs in becomes BPA admin; the installation page separately says that, as of BPA version 2.5, installation does not create an admin by default and the current user must be set up as a BPA admin.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/finance/business-performance-analytics/install-bpa, which states: 'As of Business performance analytics version 2.5, the installation process doesn't create Business performance analytics admin by default. You must set up your current user as a Business performance analytics admin.'

claims.claim: Both BPA and finance and operations security permissions are required for Analytics MCP access.
claims.quote: access is controlled through Business performance analytics user roles and Dynamics 365 finance and operations security roles. Users must have appropriate permissions in both systems to access data through the MCP server.

claims.claim: The mixed model reflects included BPA entitlement alongside potentially metered Copilot Studio agent use.
claims.quote: Business performance analytics is an innovative reporting tool that's included as part of the Dynamics 365 Finance license.

claims.claim: Variable cost reflects Copilot Credits consumption rather than a claim of free agent execution.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are the unit that measures agent usage. You calculate the total cost based on the sum of the Copilot Credits your organization uses.

claims.claim: Analytics MCP exposes the coverage available in the tenant's BPA environment.
claims.quote: The MCP server exposes what's available in your Business performance analytics environment. If certain data areas aren't covered by Business performance analytics, they won't be accessible through the MCP server.

claims.claim: The Allowed MCP clients list is documented for the separate Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server.
claims.quote: When you enable the Dynamics 365 ERP MCP server in your environment, choose which agent platforms can access the server.

claims.claim: The Allowed MCP clients documentation does not confirm that this list governs ERP Analytics MCP.
claims.quote: Searched: ERP Analytics MCP Allowed MCP clients block registry. Read ERP MCP security, Analytics overview, technical details, FAQ and build guide. The Allowed MCP clients section names ERP MCP; Analytics documentation specifies authentication clients but not that allow-list.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center can block an MCP server in its registry.
claims.quote: Select Agents > Tools, and then select the Registry tab. Select an MCP server from the list to open its overview pane. Select Block to restrict the server across your organization, or Unblock to restore access to a previously blocked server.

claims.claim: The cited admin-center documentation does not establish that its registry block covers this Analytics MCP server.
claims.quote: Searched: msdyn_ERPAnalyticsMCPServer registry; ERP Analytics MCP Agent 365 governance blocking. Read management page and Analytics VS Code endpoint excerpt. No Analytics registration/block scope stated; management warns against assuming cross-product reach.

claims.claim: Learn advises tracking data access patterns through the MCP server.
claims.quote: Monitor data access patterns - Track which data sources and measures are being accessed through the MCP server.

claims.claim: The Analytics technical guidance names no log or report for tracking those data access patterns.
claims.quote: Searched: ERP Analytics MCP monitoring audit logs automatic enablement default; ERP Analytics MCP enable disable server switch licensing pricing meter monitoring logs Allowed MCP clients. Read Analytics technical details, overview and FAQ; monitoring advice names no log or report.
